description:
• Brand Introduction: Simube is a team dedicated to providing the best racing simulator products. Our goal is to bring you the thrilling experience of real car racing, where your adrenaline surges, and you feel the excitement and precision of a real race car driver's steering. We believe that while your race car may be virtual, the exhilarating feeling is real.
  • Product Description: Simube's flagship product line includes the QR2 Pro & Simube HUB, which are praised for their excellent build quality and performance on par with Fanatec's QR2. In addition, Simube offers upgrade kits for all Fanatec bases and steering wheels, making your racing simulator even more complete.
  • Unique Selling Point (USP): Simube's unique selling point lies in the superior quality of its products and their compatibility with the Fanatec system. Our products are designed to work seamlessly with Fanatec wheel bases, allowing users to easily pair third-party wheels with existing Fanatec equipment. Simube's products are well-manufactured and on the same level as original Fanatec products, offering a cost-saving solution for racing simulator users looking for value.
  • Payment Terms: Simube offers a clear payment process and competitive pricing. Products are listed with sale prices, such as various items at $45.00, ensuring transparent and easy purchasing. We offer free global shipping and returns, including duties and taxes.
  • Other Information: Simube places great emphasis on customer feedback and community engagement. We actively participate in global events and maintain a vibrant Discord channel where enthusiasts can directly engage in our product development. Your feedback drives our product development because we are always here to serve you.
payout_period: We pay commissions 3 times per month.
